name: Lustrian Reavers

specialRules.name: Rare Heroes
specialRules.text: Only one of each type of Hero may ever be bought during the existence of the warband. Heroes are bought with the weapons and armour listed in their entry and can never swap or give these away, though new equipment may be acquired.

specialRules.name: Promotions
specialRules.text: When a Hero is lost it cannot be replaced by hiring. The warband keeps the fallen Hero's weapons and armour (not other equipment) and may promote a Prospect into the role as if he had rolled Lad's Got Talent: choose two skill lists available to Heroes in the warband for the new Hero, who immediately makes one roll on the Heroes Advance table. The Prospect's own equipment goes to the stash. With no Prospect, promote the next one hired.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.text: May only hire an Ogre Bodyguard, Dwarf Trollslayer, Tilean Marksman or a Big Game Hunter.

equipmentLists.name: Heroes equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Conqueror, Saurus Slayer, Beastmaster, Jungle Shadow, Trapmaster

items.name: Misericordia
items.note: Uses dagger rules; when attacking downed enemies roll 2D6 and pick the highest 'to wound' roll

items.name: Javelin
items.note: 8" range, no penalty for moving and shooting

items.name: Lizardmen skin cloak
items.note: Saurus Slayer only. Grants 12+ ward save (printed 6+), not reduced by strength or other modifiers

items.name: Lizardman Sword upgrade
items.note: Saurus Slayer only. Upgrades any sword; +1 to wound rolls due to Poison

items.name: Trophy Slann Holy headdress
items.note: Saurus Slayer only. +2 bonus to armour saves (as printed)

items.name: Tilean Hunting Hawk
items.note: Beastmaster only (0-1). M12 WS4 BS0 S4 T3 W- I5 A1 Ld-. Part of the equipment: attacks any enemy within 12" as a melee attack, even out of line of sight (unless Hidden), then returns to the Beastmaster. Cannot be targeted separately. Does not attack if the Beastmaster is in hand-to-hand combat. Animal rules; no experience

fighters.name: Conqueror
fixedEquipment: Masterwork Heavy Armour (7+ armour save, -1 Movement)

specialRules.name: Survivor
specialRules.text: Cannot be taken out of action unless already Knocked Down or Stunned; treat Out of Action as Stunned if standing when wounded. The first time he suffers a Dead result on the Serious Injury chart, treat it as Multiple Injuries instead (once only).

fighters.notes: Any Hero may be chosen as leader (gets the Leader rule); Conqueror flagged leader as a default. Masterwork heavy armour printed 4+ save, -1M. Bec de Corbin: two hands, strikes in initiative order when charged, +1 Strength, injury roll 2-4 treated as stunned (Dwarfs immune).

fighters.name: Saurus Slayer

specialRules.name: Duelist
specialRules.text: If engaged with only a single opponent in melee, may re-roll missed hits on the first turn whether he charged or was charged.

fighters.notes: May buy Saurus Slayer special equipment (cloak, skull mask, Lizardman sword, headdress) listed in the Heroes list.

specialRules.name: War Beasts
specialRules.text: May include up to 2 War Beasts (Estalian Warhound 0-2, Barbary Monkey 0-1). They count toward the warband maximum, must be bought when the warband is created (replaceable if killed) and use the Beastmaster's Ld within 6". If the Beastmaster is lost they cannot be used until a Prospect is promoted into a new Beastmaster. War Beasts are Animals, never gain experience, and suffer injuries like Henchmen (dead on 1-4 on D12, printed 1-2 on D6).

fighters.name: Jungle Shadow

specialRules.name: Silent Hunter
specialRules.text: Always considered Hidden if touching any terrain 1" high. Shooting does not reveal him, though spellcasting does. Does not work with Blackpowder weapons.

specialRules.name: Surprise Attack
specialRules.text: If attacking an enemy from behind (shot from the 180 degree arc behind its facing), may re-roll missed to-hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Canopy Walker
specialRules.text: May re-roll all failed climbing, jumping and falling off ledges tests once.

specialRules.name: Optional Wizard
specialRules.text: For +30 gc may be a Wizard using the Lesser Magic list; generate one spell as standard; remove the Light Armour from his starting equipment.

fighters.notes: Wizard upgrade is optional; spellcaster field left null.

fighters.name: Trapmaster
fixedEquipment: Tilean Hunting Rifle (as Hochland Long Rifle)

specialRules.name: Deadeye
specialRules.text: No penalties for shooting at long range.

specialRules.name: Traps
specialRules.text: Starts each game with 1 Trap and may buy up to 5 more at 5 gc each before the game. One use each, used in the Shooting phase instead of shooting (not if he ran, not in melee). Place 2 trap counters (1 false, 1 real) of 1" diameter within 3" of the Trapmaster and at least 3" from other models. A model moving within 2" must flip one; a real one causes D3 S5 hits (no criticals). Remove counters when sprung.

fighters.notes: Firepots of Miragliano: 8" range, no long-range penalty, S2 hit; target tests Initiative at start of next turn or cannot charge or shoot until the following turn.

specialRules.name: Promotion Only
specialRules.text: Re-roll any Lad's Got Talent result on the Henchmen Advancement table. When promoted a new Prospect may be hired as the model no longer counts as one.

fighters.name: Estalian Warhound

specialRules.name: War Beast
specialRules.text: Requires a Beastmaster; uses his Ld within 6". Animal, never gains experience.

fighters.notes: Counts toward the 2 War Beast limit with the Barbary Monkey.

fighters.name: Barbary Monkey

specialRules.name: Nimble
specialRules.text: Can climb any sheer surface without Initiative tests, re-roll failed Diving Charge tests, can enter buildings unlike other animals. Has a 9+ ward save (printed 5+) against all wounds from melee, shooting, magic or falling.

specialRules.name: War Beast
specialRules.text: Requires a Beastmaster; uses his Ld within 6". Animal, never gains experience.

fighters.notes: Counts toward the 2 War Beast limit with the Warhound.

conversionNotes: PDF is a scan with no text layer; read from images.

Conversions applied: Masterwork Heavy Armour 4+ save -> 7+; Estalian Warhound 5+ armour save -> 9+; Barbary Monkey 5+ ward -> 9+; Lizardmen skin cloak 6+ ward -> natural 12 (12+). War beast dead on 1-2 on D6 -> 1-4 on D12 (proportional; schema only lists 1 -> 1-2, confirm). Trophy headdress +2 armour save bonus left as printed. Bec de Corbin injury 2-4 stunned left as printed.

Estalian Warhound and Barbary Monkey are henchman fighters (bought at creation, count toward model limit); the Tilean Hunting Hawk is an item in the Heroes list because the PDF says it is part of the equipment. Warhound and Warhorse also appear in the Heroes list as printed.
Leader: PDF lets any Hero be chosen as leader; Conqueror is flagged isLeader as a default.
Each Hero type is 0-1 (only one of each type ever, no minimum), although the warband needs at least one Hero.
Trap cost (5 gc each) and Saurus Slayer special equipment prices are in notes/list items. Jungle Shadow wizard upgrade (+30 gc) is optional.
